description: This Java class 'ApiProperties' defines configuration properties for API testing in the Fineract project. It uses Spring annotations to inject configuration values such as base URL, credentials, tenant ID, and read timeout, and provides getter methods via Lombok's @Getter annotation.

classes.name: ApiProperties
classes.description: A Spring component that holds API configuration properties with values injected from external configuration sources.
